cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've spilled paint on my sofa. I've approved a rescue operation. Stay there; I'll get a cloth.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I use it on the carpet too? It's spread.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My birthday carpet. Wonderful. Keep blotting; you're doing well, and I'll hold the clean edge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cloth's making it worse. Can we stop?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stopping is approved. Good catch. Take my clean shirt instead. I am absolutely furious, but you are not facing this alone.

reason: Keep praise and practical help as damage worsens, using B request to stop the failed method as an approval decision that produces A more costly help.
